title: SB 1210 (109th General Assembly): As introduced, permits any registered Tennessee voter to vote absentee for any reason after providing evidence of identification in the application for a ballot; exempts certain absentee voters from the evidence of identification requirement under certain circumstances. - Amends TCA Title 2.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) TCA 2-6-201(a) (changed)
(quote) deleting the language “outlined in this part” and substituting instead the language “outlined in this part without providing evidence of identification, as defined in § 2-7-112(c)”.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) TCA 2-6-201(b) (new)
(quote) A registered voter may vote absentee by mail according to the procedures outlined in this part in any primary election, election, or runoff election. A registered voter shall not be required to provide a reason in order to cast an absentee ballot by mail; provided, that the voter submits a legible scanned copy of evidence of identification, as defined in § 2-7-112(c), with the application for a by-mail absentee ballot.
(section) TCA 2-6-202(a)(3)(G) (replaced)
(quote) (G) A legible scanned copy of evidence of identification, as defined in § 2-7-112(c), except as provided in § 2-6-201(a).
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 1: designates existing 2-6-201 language as (a) and adds (b), no-excuse absentee by mail for any primary, election or runoff, if a scanned ID copy goes with the application.
(other) Section 2: changes the existing excuse-based 2-6-201(a) so it covers absentee voting without the ID copy.
(other) Section 3: replaces item (G) of the absentee application contents with the scanned-ID-copy item.
(other) Section 4: in 2-6-401(c) deletes the words 'or that category of persons otherwise' (effect not explained in the text).
(other) Section 5: takes effect July 1, 2015.
(other) version: Draft 1123822 (2015-02-12): only version saved. Carries slot c (and a cross-reference in a). No amendments saved.
(other) note: Companion House Bill 553 (cover). Recommended by Senate State and Local Government 6-2 on 2015-04-07 and sent to Finance, Ways, and Means, where action was deferred; no later action. No amendments saved or listed. The ID is a scanned copy of 'evidence of identification' as defined in 2-7-112(c); the text does not say whether that list changes.

votes.motion: Senate State and Local Government Committee, recommended for passage [version voted: Draft 1123822 (no amendments)]
